premises.text: Green-energy scale-up depends on batteries whose current metals are toxic and too scarce for deep decarbonization
premises.evidence_span: The metals that we use in our current battery tech are not only toxic, but very scarce as well

premises.text: Hydrogel-reinforced cellulose paper with zinc and manganese chemistry yields rechargeable paper batteries
premises.evidence_span: We have invented what we call hydrogel-reinforced cellulose paper, and utilize zinc and manganese as the two sides of the battery

premises.text: The batteries are fully compostable at end of life, lowering recycling cost and environmental impact
premises.evidence_span: our batteries are fully compostable, which means at the end of its lifecycle, you can throw it into the ground, and within a month, it would completely degrade

premises.text: Paper form factor enables flexible, bendable, cut-safe operation without fire or overheating hazards
premises.evidence_span: our batteries can be bent while operational without affecting its performance or causing any kind of safety hazard

premises.text: Stacked paper cells are a plug-and-play lithium replacement manufacturable on existing processes and equipment
premises.evidence_span: stack up these paper batteries into the required shape and size, and we practically have a plug-and-play solution to replace any type of lithium batteries

premises.text: Abundant materials make the batteries about ten times cheaper than alternatives
premises.evidence_span: the cost of making our paper batteries isn't two times or three times cheaper, but it's 10 times cheaper

premises.text: Specialized variants target energy storage, lightweight consumer/wearable devices, and eventually EVs via partner channels
premises.evidence_span: three versions of specialized paper batteries for a focused area of application

value.text: Safer, more sustainable, and much cheaper batteries that enable greener energy infrastructure
value.evidence_span: Sustainable, cost-effective, and so much safer than the ones we're using today

causal_links.evidence_span: a dream of a greener future demands greener batteries. And that's precisely where Flynn's paper batteries come in
